name.description: The name of the library, which names its directory and, with the scope, its package

directory.description: The directory the library is created under (e.g., 'libs' or 'libs/utils')

scope.description: The npm scope of the package (e.g., '@acme'). Defaults to the scope of the root package.json's name, or no scope when it has none.

projectName.description: The project's name, as tasks address it. Defaults to the library's name.

packageName.description: The package's name. Defaults to the library's name under the scope.

tags.description: The tags the module boundaries read (e.g., 'type:util,scope:internal')

publishable.description: Whether the library is published to npm: when true, the generator named make-publishable runs on it next

keywords.description: npm keywords for the package, used only when publishable is true

formats.description: The bundle formats the package builds, among esm, cjs, iife and umd; used only when publishable is true
